newsitem.title: USA: CFTC finalizes rules for daily options reporting.
newsitem.headline: CFTC finalizes rules for daily options reporting.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a final rule on Friday requiring clearing members and foreign brokers to file options large trader reports daily.

In a notice published in the Federal Register, the CFTC said the changes include a joint options and futures reporting level, a new record format for reporting information in machine-readable form and an earlier time for submission of the data. The rules are scheduled to take effect on Oct. 1, the agency said.
The changes are intended to align the CFTC's reporting rules with those of the exchanges and may allow some exchanges to obtain data from the Commission rather than from reporting firms.
The changes also mean that exchanges will no longer be required to file weekly options large trader reports once all firms are providing the daily reports.
